scripts.audit: pnpm run audit:architecture && pnpm run audit:ts && pnpm run audit:shell
scripts.audit:ts: biome check src/ web/src/ web/tests/ && pnpm run test:ts && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && knip --include files,dependencies,unlisted --exclude binaries --no-config-hints && knip --directory web --include files,dependencies,unlisted --exclude binaries --no-config-hints
scripts.audit:ts:fix: biome check --fix src/ web/src/ web/tests/ && pnpm run audit:ts
scripts.audit:shell: find installer skills -type f -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n && bash -n installer/bin/flitterbot-up installer/bin/flitterbot-wa && node --check installer/install.mjs && node --check installer/uninstall.mjs
